# Fixture provenance

All payloads in provider.ts and inline tests are independently authored synthetic data,
shaped against the 2026-09-21 documentation baseline in docs/provider-evidence.md.
No customer, taxpayer, production key, signed provider artifact URL or observed staging
response is included. example.invalid links are inert data, never download targets.
Property seeds are pinned in test/property/safety.test.ts. Synthetic success is not
evidence that an account is authorized to issue or that undocumented provider behavior works.
